title: MSA One 51 available
message: MSA One 51 adds native folder access, persisted Android file permissions, restart-safe PDF reopening, native Downloads saving and Android system-bar inset handling.
releaseNotes: Native Android folder picker with persisted access
Re-scan a previously connected folder without selecting it again
Office exports save to Downloads/MSA One on Android
Android 15/16 header and system-bar inset handling
Hardened Capacitor plugin integration retains WebView security
